hero.description:
On a recent family trip to Orlando, I noticed that we were staying right around the corner from the abandoned theme park Splendid China.
How could I pass up an opportunity to head in for some photos?!

The park was built in 1993 at a cost of ~$100m, and closed 10 years later (2003).  So here is what it looks like as it slowly rots in the Florida sun almost 10 years later...
categories: Derelict buildings in the United States
